<function name="GetCurrentViewOffset" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Gets the current applied view offset, which transitions between the player's standing and ducked view offset depending on their duck state.

Do not confuse with <page>Player:GetViewOffset</page> and <page>Player:GetViewOffsetDucked</page>, which always return the standing or ducked offset respectively.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Vector">The actual view offset.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
